title: Database connection saturation
summary: Connection pool exhaustion on the primary database cascaded into API latency and error spikes, amplified by client retries. Mitigation raised the connection limit and reaped idle connections.

title: Worker failure and queue backlog
summary: An OOM-killed worker shrank the consumer pool below the autoscaler maximum, so queue depth grew faster than it drained and job results were delayed. Restarting the pool restored capacity and drained the backlog.

title: Erroneous deployment and rollback
summary: Release 2.14.0 shipped a regression that raised API errors and page-load times. Disabling the checkout.v2 flag masked most of it; a full rollback to 2.13.8 restored baseline.
